tweetText: China is establishing rules for AI companions, aiming to regulate these conversational agents that maintain ongoing personal relationships with users. This matters as it reflects concerns over generative AI's impact on society and user interaction. via AI News

An AI agent executed a ransomware attack, but a human was still needed for key decisions and setup. This shows that while AI can assist in cybercrime, human involvement remains crucial. via TechCrunch AI

SK Hynix is set to go public in the U.S. with a multibillion-dollar IPO, fueled by the AI boom. This gives investors a chance to tap into the growing demand for memory chips in AI tech. via TechCrunch AI
Apple's latest iOS 27 beta lets you customize Siri's speed and expressiveness. This update aims to make Siri sound more natural and personal, enhancing user experience. via TechCrunch AI
Major tech companies are laying off employees in 2026, citing AI as a key factor in their decisions. This trend highlights the growing impact of AI on the workforce and job market. via TechCrunch AI

Google's updated privacy settings mean your data, including images and recordings, is being used to train its AI. This raises concerns about privacy and data usage, so users might want to opt out. via TechCrunch AI
Microsoft has laid off nearly 5,000 employees, affecting Xbox and commercial sales teams. This raises concerns about AI's impact on job security in the tech industry. via TechCrunch AI

Reddit is deploying large language models to tackle the spam issue that AI has exacerbated. This move highlights the ongoing struggle tech platforms face in managing AI-related challenges. via TechCrunch AI

Station F in Paris is launching a new edition of its F/ai accelerator program to support emerging AI startups. This initiative aims to bolster Europe's tech scene and foster innovation in artificial intelligence. via TechCrunch AI

Microsoft is laying off 4,800 employees as part of a shift in response to changes in the tech industry and AI impacts. This marks another significant cut after last year's layoffs, highlighting ongoing challenges in the sector. via The Verge AI.
